    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbstractProjectContextProvider
    Common base class for context providers that are bound to a specific IntelliJ project.
    AgiContext
    Bridge between IntelliJ VirtualFile selections and the per-session Anahata ResourceManager, backing the Project-view "AGI Context" node decorator and popup action.
    AgiContextActionGroup
    Dynamic "AGI Context" popup group for the Project-view context menu, listing one toggle per active AGI session that adds/removes the selected files from that session's context.
    AgiContextDecorator
    Badges Project-view nodes whose file or directory is in one or more active AGI session contexts.
    AnahataConfigurable
    A native Settings page (Settings → Tools → Anahata ASI) for the plugin defaults.
    AnahataFileIconProvider
    Provides a branded Anahata logo icon for anahata.md files in IntelliJ IDEA.
    AnahataNotifications
    Thin helper for surfacing Anahata events as IDE balloon notifications.
    AnahataSettings
    Application-level persisted settings for the Anahata ASI plugin.
    AnahataStatusBarWidget
    Status-bar widget showing the number of active Anahata sessions, with a click that focuses the Anahata tool window.
    AnahataStatusBarWidgetFactory
    Factory that contributes the Anahata active-sessions status-bar widget.
    AnahataToolWindowFactory
    Factory for creating the Anahata ASI Tool Window in IntelliJ.
    AnahataTreeStructureProvider
    Surfaces the project's anahata.md instructions file as a branded node at the top of the Project view.
    AnahataTreeStructureProvider.AnahataNode
    A navigable Project-view node representing the project's anahata.md instructions.
    BatchCodeRefiner
    Structural, member-level Java refinement (the IntelliJ V4 AST-Guided Batch engine).
    BatchCodeRefiner.WriteBody
    A mutating batch body that may raise a domain-level AgiToolException.
    CodeModel
    Provides tools for interacting with the Java code model in IntelliJ IDEA.
    CodeRefinementBatch
    An atomic batch of member-level CodeRefinementIntents applied to a single Java file by BatchCodeRefiner#refine.
    CodeRefinementIntent
    A single structural, member-level modification to one Java file, applied by BatchCodeRefiner against the live PSI tree.
    CodeRefinementIntent.Type
    The kind of structural modification performed by an intent.
    CodeRefiner
    AST-based, non-textual maintenance operations on Java source files: structural import management, IDE-rule reformatting, and annotation insertion.
    CodeRefiner.WriteBody
    A mutating PSI operation that may raise a domain-level AgiToolException.
    Debugger
    A toolkit for driving the IntelliJ debugger (breakpoints, debug sessions, expression evaluation).
    Debugger.CapturingValueNode
    An XValueNode that captures a value's textual presentation into an AtomicReference and releases a latch, bridging the asynchronous presentation callback to the synchronous evaluate tool.
    Debugger.CollectingCompositeNode
    An XCompositeNode that collects computed children as name = value lines into a StringBuilder, bridging the asynchronous children callback to the synchronous variable-listing tool.
    Debugger.TextAccumulatingRenderer
    An XValuePresentation.XValueTextRenderer that accumulates every rendered fragment into a single string, so a value's rich presentation can be flattened to plain text.
    Editor
    Provides tools for interacting with the IntelliJ IDEA source editor: opening files, navigating to lines, listing open editors, and closing editors.
    Gradle
    A toolkit for running Gradle tasks in projects linked to IntelliJ's external-system framework.
    Hints
    Surfaces IntelliJ's on-the-fly analysis (inspections + annotators) for a file.
    IDE
    Provides tools for interacting with the IntelliJ IDEA IDE itself: tailing the IDE log, revealing files in the Project view, and reporting the state of the tool-window system.
    IntellijAgiConfig
    IntelliJ-specific AGI configuration.
    IntellijAsiContainer
    Concrete implementation of the ASI Container for IntelliJ IDEA.
    IntellijHandle
    An IntelliJ-native reactive resource handle that wraps physical and virtual files.
    IntellijHandlePanel
    Specialized metadata panel for the IntellijHandle.
    IntellijIconProvider
    An IntelliJ-specific implementation of IconProvider that fetches authentic IDE file type icons and project icons for the context tree.
    IntellijJava
    An IntelliJ-aware extension of the core Java toolkit that can compile and execute dynamic scripts on the application JVM and against a specific open project's classpath.
    IntellijJavaCodeParameterRenderer
    Specialized parameter renderer for dynamic Java code execution in IntelliJ IDEA.
    IntellijPluginUtils
    Utility class for introspecting the IntelliJ IDEA runtime and assembling the full plugin classpath.
    IntellijResourceUI
    IntelliJ-specific implementation of ResourceUI.
    IntellijTextResourceViewer
    An IntelliJ IDEA native text resource viewer that provides full IDE editor fidelity (syntax highlighting, line numbers, folding, and theme synchronization) using IntelliJ's EditorFactory.
    IntellijTextResourceWriteRenderer
    IntelliJ diff renderer for any AbstractTextResourceWrite tool-call argument (full-file updates, replacements, line edits).
    IntellijTextResourceWriteRenderer.CommentGutterRenderer
    A gutter marker that shows an AI line comment as its tooltip on the proposed pane.
    JavaHierarchyNode
    A recursive DTO representing a node in the Java type hierarchy inside IntelliJ IDEA.
    JavaMember
    A lightweight, serializable "keychain" DTO that uniquely identifies a Java class member (field, method, constructor, etc.) inside the IntelliJ IDEA platform.
    JavaMemberPage
    A specialized Page for JavaMember that holds a single URL representing the source/class file for all members in the page.
    JavaPsi
    Shared, stateless PSI/VFS resolution utilities for the IntelliJ toolkits.
    JavaType
    A lightweight, serializable "keychain" DTO that uniquely identifies a Java type.
    JcefMediaViewerImpl
    Native IntelliJ video and media viewer powered by the Chromium Embedded Framework (JCEF).
    Maven
    A toolkit for inspecting and building Maven projects through the IntelliJ IDEA Maven integration.
    OpenToolWindowsContextProvider
    Injects a live snapshot of the IntelliJ windowing system — every registered tool window per open project, flagged with its visible/active state — into the RAG message.
    ProjectAlertsContextProvider
    Provides a real-time list of project compiler errors and alerts.
    ProjectContextProvider
    A hierarchical context provider for a specific IntelliJ project.
    Projects
    A toolkit for interacting with the IntelliJ IDEA Project APIs.
    ProjectStructureContextProvider
    Provides a source-root-aware map of a project's Java structure.
    Refactor
    Programmatic Java refactoring for IntelliJ IDEA: project-wide rename, safe delete, and find-usages.
    RelativePosition
    Placement of an inserted or moved member relative to its target class or an anchor member, used by CodeRefinementIntent.
    RunConfigurations
    A toolkit for discovering and launching IntelliJ run/debug/test configurations.
    Terminals
    A toolkit for opening, driving and closing IntelliJ terminal tabs.
    ToggleAgiContextAction
    A single session's toggle within the "AGI Context" popup: checked when the selected files are all in that session's context, and adds/removes them on toggle.
    Vcs
    A toolkit for inspecting version-control status through IntelliJ's generic VCS layer.
